sources.note: SECOND-HAND and only for sister lects: Bularnu (T246) under type I 'Main stress on the initial syllable, secondary stress on alternates' (QS flag; ref. Breen n.d. 'Bularna grammar and phonology' ms AIATSIS); Wagaya (T247) under type VI 'Stress is on the second syllable if it is heavy, otherwise on the first', 'No reference.
